versions.content: If the processed NVRAM block is of type NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT the job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall start to copy the data of the RAM block to NV block which has not been read during the jobs started by NvM_ReadBlock, NvM_ReadPRAMBlock or NvM_ReadAll then continue to copy the other NV block.

If the processed NVRAM block is of type NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT the job of the function NvM_WriteBlock shall start to copy the data of the RAM block to NV block which has not been read during the jobs started by NvM_ReadBlock, NvM_ReadPRAMBlock or NvM_ReadAll then continue to copy the other NV block.
